Chapter 228: Chapter 18 The Despair Of Heiyu Ao_2

Chapter 228: Chapter 18 The Despair of Heiyu Ao_2

Song Wuyang’s tone was somewhat constrained.

“What great man, not great man.”

Nolan Chenxi seemed very amiable, completely lacking the imposing aura and unapproachability that Song Wuyang remembered.

“The Canglan Star you govern is truly remarkable, having given birth to such a great Evolver.”

Nolan Chenxi said with a smile.

“What?” Song Wuyang blinked.

...

He understood every word that Nolan Chenxi said, but when put together, Song Wuyang didn’t know what to make of it.

What does ‘truly remarkable’ mean?

Nolan Chenxi, as the Vice President of the Dawn Association, wouldn’t even spare high-grade life planets a glance, let alone Canglan Star.

And yet, now, this big shot from the Dawn Star System was voluntarily praising Canglan Star?

Also?

A great Evolver was born?

Song Wuyang still hadn’t comprehended.

He was well aware of the number of Evolvers on Canglan Star and their specific circumstances; there certainly wasn’t any ‘great Evolver’ as referred to by the esteemed Nolan Chenxi.

“Lord Nolan… I’m not sure what you mean…”

Song Wuyang asked cautiously.

“I forgot this matter hasn’t reached Canglan Star yet.”

Nolan Chenxi’s smile did not diminish as his gaze turned even more affable. “You should know about Peak Master Shisan, right?”

“Peak Master Shisan?”

Song Wuyang was stunned.

Of course, he knew of Peak Master Shisan.

He was the pride of the Chikun Star Domain, who not long ago had challenged the genius Evolvers of the various star domains.

Even the undefeated Holy Son from the Wanyang Star Domain had been forced to bow his head in defeat at the hands of Peak Master Shisan.

Song Wuyang not only knew of Peak Master Shisan but had also watched every one of his challenges, almost becoming a fan.

But…

What did Peak Master Shisan have to do with him?

If the Dawn Star System could dare to fantasize, then maybe Peak Master Shisan came from their star system.

But as for Song Wuyang, he didn’t even dare to fantasize about it, because the probability was too low, nearly impossible.

With over a million life planets in the Chikun Star Domain, including high-grade life planets and various main stars and so on.

Why on earth would the great Peak Master Shisan come from a backward and remote planet like Canglan Star?

It was completely unscientific.

“Lord Nolan, this Peak Master Shisan…”

Song Wuyang asked, puzzled.

“That’s right.”

Nolan Chenxi nodded: “The true identity of the great Peak Master Shisan is indeed an Evolver named ‘Lin Yuan’ from your Canglan Star.”

“Also, Peak Master Shisan has participated in a tournament and even won the championship, you should remember.”

Nolan Chenxi’s tone remained kind as he spoke.

“The true identity of Peak Master Shisan is ‘Lin Yuan’…”

Song Wuyang was dumbfounded, almost unable to comprehend at the moment.

Almost immediately after, Song Wuyang’s eyes widened in shock, hardly able to keep his composure.

Peak Master Shisan was Lin Yuan?

Lin Yuan was Peak Master Shisan?

Song Wuyang felt dizzy, as if knocked over by a huge surprise.

No, that wasn’t right.

This was more than just a surprise.

“The true identity of Peak Master Shisan will be announced by the Chenxi Mainstar, and soon your Canglan Star will also be informed. I told you in advance as a preparation,” Nolan Chenxi said. “Moreover, soon the Guard Troops of our President will come over to protect the family of Peak Master Shisan; by then, you should know what to do.”

Nolan Chenxi reminded him.

“Rest assured, Lord Nolan, before the President’s Guard Troops arrive, Canglan Star’s defense system will be completely sealed off, barring any forces from entering,” Song Wuyang said immediately after taking a deep breath.

“Then I’ll leave it to the Governor,” Nolan Chenxi said with a nod, his face showing satisfaction.

Although he thought that no one would reach Peak Master Shisan’s parents faster than his Dawn Association.

But it’s better to be safe than sorry.

Having extra precautions was never a bad thing.

“You may go now to make the arrangements, remember, the most important task for Canglan Star at the moment is to protect the family of Peak Master Shisan until the President’s Guard Troops arrive.”

Having said this, Nolan Chenxi then disconnected the call.

Thump.

Song Wuyang fell to the ground with a thud.

“Lord Lin Yuan.”

“Lord Peak Master Shisan.”

Song Wuyang’s mind was whirring.

He immediately thought of the time when Lin Yuan was oppressed by public opinion on Canglan Star due to the Heiyu Family’s repression.

“Draw up the list.”

“From the moment the Heiyu Family severed trade with Canglan Star, every citizen on the network who has verbally insulted and blamed Mr. Lin Yuan, regardless of their status, will be added to the list.”

Song Wuyang immediately began to make arrangements.

He couldn’t allow Master Shisan, to even conceive the idea of suffering the slightest grievance on Canglan Star.

…

Heiyu Ao was full of vigor, having the business map provided by the family’s think tank; he just needed to follow it step by step.

“Mr. Ao.”

“The training is proceeding normally, and the increase in strength of all Evolvers is in line with expectations.”

The elder in the black suit, Bei Zhao, reported the results respectfully.

“Hmm.”

“I see.”

Heiyu Ao was pleased in spirit.

If the plan went smoothly, in the next championship tournament, those Evolvers cultivated by Heiyu Ao would shine brilliantly.

“The Evolvers practicing ‘divination’ are terrifying, able to grasp any minute information and thus make the most beneficial decisions for themselves…”

Heiyu Ao felt a touch of emotion.

If it weren’t for the list provided by the family’s think tank, how could he, Heiyu Ao, have known about the tremendous potential for improvement in these Evolvers? That a little training could greatly boost their strength?

Just then.

“My father is looking for me?”

Heiyu Ao tensed up.

He received a video call from his father.

This left Heiyu Ao somewhat at a loss.

Heiyu Ao’s father, the Sea-Calming Divine Needle of the Heiyu Family, the Seventh Rank Evolver Heiyu Mo.

As the youngest son of Heiyu Mo, Heiyu Ao had met his father fewer times than he could count on both hands.

Let alone receiving a personal video call from him.

“Could it be that father has discovered my achievements outside?”

Heiyu Ao speculated in his heart and quickly accepted his father’s call.

On the virtual screen before him.

Heiyu Mo’s image soon appeared.

Heiyu Mo was tall and emitted a certain dark and chilly aura.

“Heiyu Ao.”

Heiyu Mo spoke in a cold tone, “I’ve sent someone to fetch you. Don’t resist when they arrive.”

After saying this,

Heiyu Mo ended the call.

“Huh?”

Heiyu Ao was confused.

His father, the Sea-Calming Divine Needle of the Heiyu Family, had video called him personally just to tell him this?

“Fetching me back to the family?”

Heiyu Ao fell silent.

He had dreamed of returning to the family.

But the words of his father, Heiyu Mo, made him uneasy.

“What has happened?”

Heiyu Ao furrowed his brow in deep thought.

“Mr. Ao.” At that moment, the elder in the black suit, Bei Zhao, suddenly walked in.

“Chenxi Mainstar has announced the identity of Master Shisan.”

“Oh?” Heiyu Ao’s spirit was immediately uplifted, and he quickly connected to the Virtual World to receive the relevant files.

“The real identity of Master Shisan… is Lin Yuan from Canglan Star…”

Heiyu Ao was stunned. He disconnected from the Virtual World, shook his head to fully wake himself up, and then re-entered the Virtual World.

Yet, the file regarding Master Shisan’s true identity still identified him as Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan of Canglan Star.

“How can this be?” Heiyu Ao was in disbelief, “The great Master Shisan, why would he come from a backward Middle-grade Life Planet?”

The fact that Master Shisan was from Canglan Star, though shocking, was manageable.

What Heiyu Ao found unbelievable was that the Evolver he had targeted at random could actually be Master Shisan?

“Why?”

“Why am I so unlucky.”

The files came from the official source of Chenxi Mainstar, leaving no doubt as to their authenticity.

Combined with the attitude of his father, Heiyu Mo, just moments ago, Heiyu Ao realized the magnitude of his offense.

“It’s over.”

Heiyu Ao’s face turned ashen.

He was well aware of the consequences of offending Master Shisan.

Even if Master Shisan didn’t pursue the matter, his father, Heiyu Mo, with his character, would never let it go.

As Heiyu Ao trembled with fear,

a figure in a black overcoat appeared silently.

Standing behind Heiyu Ao, the figure spoke in an icy tone: “Mr. Ao, please come with me.”
